digest.component_or_area: plan review LLM caching and prompt structure
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier prompts currently render through different code paths with no shared plan-bearing prefix, preventing Anthropic's cache from recognizing byte-identical leading segments across passes.
The verifier places the plan in the USER message (below the volatile marker) instead of the system prompt, denying the system block any plan-bearing cache benefit within a multi-chunk verify step.

A single-source structural invariant (one function in prompts.py) must enforce byte identity of a shared leading prefix across Pass-1 finder and both verifier system prompts to enable provider-side prefix reuse.
Incremental-depth BLOCK loops require an exhaustiveness directive in the reviewing stance to ensure all independent defects are surfaced within a single pass rather than deferred to later rounds.
The Pass-1 warm gate currently measures plan tokens alone but must measure the actual cached prefix (preamble + plan) to correctly decide whether prefix caching is viable.
